text: I'll continue the ledger with the fourth source.

**image-D.png:** A solid plus/cross shape — two equal-width bars crossing at right angles, with sharp corners and a horizontal arm wider than the vertical one, centered in the frame. The fill is a deep saturated purple/magenta (roughly #800080), flat and uniform with no shading. Below the shape, printed black text reads **"D40"** in the same plain sans-serif as the earlier labels, centered near the bottom. Background is plain light/white; no other marks, borders, or text.

Now the fifth source.

**image-E.png:** A filled diamond (a square rotated ~45° so its corners point up, down, left, and right), centered in the frame with sharp vertices. The fill is a bright, saturated orange/amber (roughly #FFA500), flat and uniform with no gradient or outline. Below the diamond, printed text reads **"E51"** in a bold black sans-serif — noticeably heavier weight than the earlier labels — roughly centered but appearing slightly right of center. Background is plain light/white; no other text or marks.

Now the sixth source.

## Handoff ledger

1. **image-D.png** — solid purple plus/cross with right-angled bars, centered; black sans-serif label "D40" below.
2. **image-E.png** — solid orange/amber diamond (rotated square), centered; bold black sans-serif label "E51" below, slightly right of center.
3. **image-F.png** — solid black five-pointed star with one point upward, centered; bold black sans-serif label "F62" below.

Across D–F, all three keep the same 384×384 plain light background and center-bottom label placement seen in A–C; only the shape, fill color, and label text/weight vary. Notable drift: labels remain "Letter+two digits" pattern (D40, E51, F62) but D is regular weight while E and F are visibly bold. Gaps worth flagging: no new shape family beyond polygon/star/cross, so the series has not introduced curved or unfilled variants. All reads via official read_image; no other tools used, no earlier sources re-read.
